subject: DI04005011

body.en:
Definition

Pharmaceuticals are substances/products manufactured and quality-controlled for prevention,diagnosis or treatment of disease or alteration of physiological function.An active pharmaceutical ingredient(API) is the active component;dosage-form formulation is a separate manufacturing stage.Chemical identity alone is not evidence of pharmaceutical quality.

Anesthetics and analgesics

Anesthetics reversibly reduce sensation;general agents produce a controlled unconscious state(example propofol),while local agents block sensation in a region(example lidocaine).Analgesics relieve pain without necessarily causing anesthesia:non-opioid examples paracetamol and aspirin;opioid example morphine.These categories explain use,not patient selection or dose.

Antimalarial and antitubercular drugs

Antimalarials act against malaria parasites:examples artemisinin derivatives and chloroquine;appropriate use depends on species,resistance and clinical guidance.Antitubercular drugs treat tuberculosis:examples isoniazid,rifampicin,pyrazinamide and ethambutol;combination/regimen selection requires professional protocols and resistance assessment.They are not interchangeable with routine painkillers.

Antibiotics and vitamins

Antibiotics are antimicrobial agents historically derived from microorganisms or their modified products;penicillins and tetracyclines are examples.They do not treat every infection or viral illness.Vitamins are essential organic micronutrients needed in small amounts:fat-soluble A,D,E,K;water-soluble B-group and C.Vitamin function differs by molecule,for example C in collagen-related metabolism and D in calcium/bone physiology;excess is not automatically beneficial.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Disease prevention,diagnosis/treatment અથવા physiological function માટે manufacture/quality-control કરેલા substances/products pharmaceuticals છે. Active pharmaceutical ingredient(API) active component છે;dosage-form formulation અલગ stage છે. ફક્ત chemical identityથી pharmaceutical quality સાબિત થતી નથી.

Anesthetics તથા Analgesics

Anesthetics sensationને reversibly ઘટાડે છે;general agents controlled unconscious state આપે છે(example propofol),local agents regionમાં sensation block કરે છે(example lidocaine). Analgesics જરૂરી anesthesia વગર pain ઓછું કરે છે:non-opioid paracetamol/aspirin તથા opioid morphine. આ use-classification છે,patient selection/dose નહીં.

Antimalarial તથા Antitubercular Drugs

Antimalarials malaria parasites સામે કાર્ય કરે છે:artemisinin derivatives/chloroquine examples છે;use species,resistance તથા clinical guidance પર આધારિત છે. Antitubercular drugs tuberculosis માટે છે:isoniazid,rifampicin,pyrazinamide તથા ethambutol;combination/regimen professional protocols/resistance assessment મુજબ હોય છે. Routine painkillersના બદલે વાપરી શકાતા નથી.

Antibiotics તથા Vitamins

Antibiotics microorganismsમાંથી અથવા modified productsથી historically બનેલા antimicrobial agents છે;penicillins/tetracyclines examples છે. દરેક infection/viral illnessની સારવાર નથી. Vitamins નાની માત્રામાં જરૂરી organic micronutrients છે:fat-soluble A,D,E,K તથા water-soluble B-group,C. દરેકનું function જુદું છે,જેમ કે C collagen-related metabolismમાં તથા D calcium/bone physiologyમાં;વધારે માત્રા આપમેળે લાભદાયી નથી.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Penicillin is selected as a representative fermentation-produced beta-lactam antibiotic;this is not a universal manufacturing flowsheet for every antibiotic.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Approved production strain,sterile nutrient medium,air and the authorised downstream solvent/buffer system.

Complex biosynthesis,not a single stoichiometric synthesis equation;antibiotic recovery must preserve the unstable active molecule.

Your supplied drawing—page 3

Penicillin is a representative fermentation antibiotic,not the manufacturing route for every antibiotic.No culture recipe or self-medication instruction.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Seed train and fermenter construction

The reference spore/seed culture develops through controlled inoculum stages before entering the production fermenter.The vessel includes sterile-air dispersion,agitation,cooling and hygienic interfaces.Nutrients/appropriate precursor feeds are managed for the chosen product.Biomass growth and product formation are related but the penicillin is not simply harvested mould powder.

2. Broth cooling,filtration and extraction

After the selected production endpoint,broth is rapidly conditioned/cooled and filtered to remove mycelium.The reference uses pH-controlled extraction of the acid form into a qualified solvent and back-extraction into an aqueous buffer/salt phase.Short controlled exposure and low-temperature handling reduce degradation.This is a product-recovery principle,not an unsupervised solvent/acid recipe.

3. Purification,crystallisation and release

Further polishing and crystallisation/isolation yield the chosen penicillin salt.Drying and contained packing protect potency and reduce cross-contamination.Identity,potency,impurities,residual solvents and microbiological requirements determine release;visual crystals or a successful fermentation alone cannot prove a safe medicine.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control sterility,aeration,foam,heat,product stability,solvent recovery,allergen containment and antimicrobial wastewater.

Properties / applications

Licensed antibiotic API for professionally controlled formulation/use;not self-medication or use of laboratory broth.

વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Penicillin representative fermentation-produced beta-lactam antibiotic તરીકે પસંદ છે;બધા antibiotics માટે આ universal manufacturing flowsheet નથી.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Approved production strain,sterile nutrient medium,air તથા authorised downstream solvent/buffer system.

Complex biosynthesis,not a single stoichiometric synthesis equation;antibiotic recovery must preserve the unstable active molecule.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Seed Train તથા Fermenter Construction

Reference spore/seed culture controlled inoculum stages પછી production fermenterમાં જાય છે. Vesselમાં sterile-air dispersion,agitation,cooling તથા hygienic interfaces છે. Nutrients/appropriate precursor feeds selected product મુજબ manage થાય છે. Biomass growth/product formation સંબંધિત છે,પણ penicillin ફક્ત harvested mould powder નથી.

2. Broth Cooling,Filtration તથા Extraction

Production endpoint પછી broth ઝડપથી condition/cool તથા filter થઈ mycelium દૂર કરે છે. Referenceમાં acid formનું qualified solventમાં pH-controlled extraction તથા aqueous buffer/salt phaseમાં back-extraction છે. Short controlled exposure/low-temperature handlingથી degradation ઘટે છે. આ recovery principle છે,unsupervised solvent/acid recipe નહીં.

3. Purification,Crystallisation તથા Release

Further polishing/crystallisationથી chosen penicillin salt મળે છે. Drying/contained packing potency બચાવે તથા cross-contamination ઘટાડે છે. Identity,potency,impurities,residual solvents તથા microbiological requirementsથી release નક્કી થાય છે;crystals/fermentationથી safe medicine સાબિત થતી નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Sterility,aeration,foam,heat,product stability,solvent recovery,allergen containment તથા antimicrobial wastewater નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Professionally controlled formulation/use માટે licensed antibiotic API;self-medication/laboratory broth માટે નહીં.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Aspirin is acetylsalicylic acid,prepared here by controlled acetylation of salicylic acid followed by crystallisation and purification.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Salicylic acid and a qualified acetylating system,with approved process aids.

C7H6O3 + (CH3CO)2O → C9H8O4 + CH3COOH.

Your supplied drawing—page 2

Partially clipped/faint source redraw;source times/temperatures are not adopted as validated manufacturing instructions.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Closed acetylation section

The closed reactor provides mixing,controlled heat transfer and containment for acetylation of the phenolic hydroxyl group.The salicylic-acid carboxyl group remains in the aspirin molecule.The supplied aspirin sheet is faint/clipped;its broad reaction/crystal-recovery duties are retained,butprinted conditions are not adopted as validated instructions.

2. Crystallisation,washing and recovery

Controlled cooling/solvent conditioning forms aspirin crystals.Filtration separates mother liquor,and approved washing removes residual acid and soluble impurities.Mother liquor/washings go to qualified recovery or treatment;they are not automatically recycled without impurity control.Crystallisation purity and isolated yield are different measurements.

3. Drying and pharmaceutical qualification

Controlled drying limits moisture and thermal/hydrolytic damage.API qualification tests identity,assay,free salicylic acid and other specified impurities/residuals.A laboratory sample is never intended for consumption,and patient use is outside this manufacturing syllabus.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control exotherm,corrosive materials,residual salicylic acid,hydrolysis,mother-liquor contaminants and solvent/waste containment.

Properties / applications

Analgesic/antipyretic API and other licensed clinical uses under professional guidance;no dose advice.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Salicylic acid તથા qualified acetylating system અને approved process aids.

1. Closed Acetylation Section

Closed reactor mixing,controlled heat transfer તથા phenolic hydroxyl groupની acetylation માટે containment આપે છે. Salicylic-acid carboxyl group aspirinમાં રહે છે. Supplied sheet faint/clipped છે;તેની broad reaction/crystal-recovery duties રાખી છે,પણ printed conditionsને validated instructions ગણ્યાં નથી.

2. Crystallisation,Washing તથા Recovery

Controlled cooling/solvent conditioningથી aspirin crystals બને છે. Filtration mother liquor જુદું કરે છે અને approved washing residual acid/soluble impurities દૂર કરે છે. Mother liquor/washings qualified recovery/treatmentમાં જાય છે;impurity control વગર automatically recycle ન થાય. Crystal purity તથા isolated yield અલગ measurements છે.

3. Drying તથા Pharmaceutical Qualification

Controlled drying moisture તથા thermal/hydrolytic damage ઘટાડે છે. API qualificationમાં identity,assay,free salicylic acid તથા specified impurities/residuals તપાસાય છે. Laboratory sample consumption માટે નથી;patient use manufacturing syllabus બહાર છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Exotherm,corrosive materials,residual salicylic acid,hydrolysis,mother-liquor contaminants તથા solvent/waste containment જરૂરી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Professional guidance હેઠળ analgesic/antipyretic API તથા other licensed uses;dose advice નથી.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Paracetamol(acetaminophen) is an analgesic/antipyretic API made here by selective N-acetylation of p-aminophenol and repeated purification.

Raw materials and chemical principle

p-Aminophenol,qualified acetylating system,approved water and activated carbon for polishing.

HOC6H4NH2 + (CH3CO)2O → HOC6H4NHCOCH3 + CH3COOH(para-substituted reactant/product).

Your supplied drawing—page 1

Technical intermediate is not automatically pharmaceutical grade;validated impurity and quality controls are essential.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Reaction and initial isolation

The supplied reactor mixes p-aminophenol with the acetylating system under controlled containment/heat transfer.The multi-effect removal section recovers acetic-acid/volatile material,then vacuum crystallisation and basket centrifuging isolate a technical intermediate.This intermediate holding stage in the original drawing must not be called the final pharmaceutical product.

2. Decolourising and recrystallisation

The intermediate is redissolved/conditioned in approved water and contacted with activated carbon to remove colour/adsorbable impurities.Filtering removes carbon before the clean liquor is recrystallised.A later centrifuge separates purified crystals;mother liquor follows a controlled recovery/purge route.

3. Drying,testing and segregation

Controlled drying yields the specified API form while limiting moisture and degradation.Testing controls identity,assay,p-aminophenol and other related impurities,residuals and physical form.Technical and qualified API streams remain segregated.No study batch is a medicine for personal use.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control selectivity,heat,colour,carbon carryover,residual p-aminophenol,purity and contaminated liquors.

Properties / applications

Licensed analgesic/antipyretic formulations after regulatory and pharmaceutical release.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Paracetamol(acetaminophen) analgesic/antipyretic API છે;અહીં p-aminophenolનું selective N-acetylation તથા repeated purificationથી બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

p-Aminophenol,qualified acetylating system તથા polishing માટે approved water/activated carbon.

HOC6H4NH2 + (CH3CO)2O → HOC6H4NHCOCH3 + CH3COOH(para-substituted reactant/product).

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 1

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Reaction તથા Initial Isolation

Supplied reactor controlled containment/heat transfer સાથે p-aminophenolને acetylating system સાથે mix કરે છે. Multi-effect removal acetic-acid/volatile material recover કરે છે;vacuum crystallisation/basket centrifuge technical intermediate આપે છે. Original drawingનું intermediate holding final pharmaceutical product નથી.

2. Decolourising તથા Recrystallisation

Intermediate approved waterમાં redissolve/condition થઈ activated carbonથી colour/adsorbable impurities દૂર કરે છે. Carbon filtration પછી clean liquor recrystallise થાય છે. Later centrifuge purified crystals આપે છે;mother liquor controlled recovery/purgeમાં જાય છે.

3. Drying,Testing તથા Segregation

Controlled dryingથી specified API form મળે છે અને moisture/degradation નિયંત્રિત થાય છે. Identity,assay,p-aminophenol/related impurities,residuals તથા physical form તપાસાય છે. Technical તથા qualified API streams અલગ રહે છે. Study batch personal-use medicine નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Selectivity,heat,colour,carbon carryover,residual p-aminophenol,purity તથા contaminated liquors નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Regulatory/pharmaceutical release પછી licensed analgesic/antipyretic formulationsમાં ઉપયોગ.

Given → Find → Formula → Substitution → Answer

1.Given:10.00g salicylic acid(M=138.12g/mol),acetylating reagent in excess;8.50g dry isolated aspirin(M=180.16).

2.Find:theoretical mass and isolated yield.

3.n=10.00/138.12=0.07240mol;1:1reaction.

4.Theoretical mass=0.07240×180.16=13.04g.

5.Yield=8.50/13.04373×100=65.17%(rounded).This does not establish assay/purity or suitability as medicine.

q.en: Explain the principle of Pharmaceuticals—definition and classification by use.
q.gu: Pharmaceuticals—વ્યાખ્યા તથા Use પ્રમાણે વર્ગીકરણનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Pharmaceuticals are substances/products manufactured and quality-controlled for prevention,diagnosis or treatment of disease or alteration of physiological function.An active pharmaceutical ingredient(API) is the active component;dosage-form formulation is a separate manufacturing stage.Chemical identity alone is not evidence of pharmaceutical quality. Anesthetics reversibly reduce sensation;general agents produce a controlled unconscious state(example propofol),while local agents block sensation in a region(example lidocaine).Analgesics relieve pain without necessarily causing anesthesia:non-opioid examples paracetamol and aspirin;opioid example morphine.These categories explain use,not patient selection or dose.
a.gu: Disease prevention,diagnosis/treatment અથવા physiological function માટે manufacture/quality-control કરેલા substances/products pharmaceuticals છે. Active pharmaceutical ingredient(API) active component છે;dosage-form formulation અલગ stage છે. ફક્ત chemical identityથી pharmaceutical quality સાબિત થતી નથી. Anesthetics sensationને reversibly ઘટાડે છે;general agents controlled unconscious state આપે છે(example propofol),local agents regionમાં sensation block કરે છે(example lidocaine). Analgesics જરૂરી anesthesia વગર pain ઓછું કરે છે:non-opioid paracetamol/aspirin તથા opioid morphine. આ use-classification છે,patient selection/dose નહીં.

q.en: Explain the principle of Antibiotic manufacture—penicillin example.

a.en: Penicillin is selected as a representative fermentation-produced beta-lactam antibiotic;this is not a universal manufacturing flowsheet for every antibiotic. Approved production strain,sterile nutrient medium,air and the authorised downstream solvent/buffer system.
a.gu: Penicillin representative fermentation-produced beta-lactam antibiotic તરીકે પસંદ છે;બધા antibiotics માટે આ universal manufacturing flowsheet નથી. Approved production strain,sterile nutrient medium,air તથા authorised downstream solvent/buffer system.

q.en: Explain the principle of Aspirin manufacture.

a.en: Aspirin is acetylsalicylic acid,prepared here by controlled acetylation of salicylic acid followed by crystallisation and purification. Salicylic acid and a qualified acetylating system,with approved process aids.
a.gu: Aspirin એટલે acetylsalicylic acid;અહીં salicylic acidની controlled acetylation પછી crystallisation/purificationથી બને છે. Salicylic acid તથા qualified acetylating system અને approved process aids.

q.en: Explain the principle of Paracetamol manufacture.

a.en: Paracetamol(acetaminophen) is an analgesic/antipyretic API made here by selective N-acetylation of p-aminophenol and repeated purification. p-Aminophenol,qualified acetylating system,approved water and activated carbon for polishing.
a.gu: Paracetamol(acetaminophen) analgesic/antipyretic API છે;અહીં p-aminophenolનું selective N-acetylation તથા repeated purificationથી બને છે. p-Aminophenol,qualified acetylating system તથા polishing માટે approved water/activated carbon.

q.en: Explain the principle of Aspirin theoretical yield.

a.en: 1.Given:10.00g salicylic acid(M=138.12g/mol),acetylating reagent in excess;8.50g dry isolated aspirin(M=180.16). 2.Find:theoretical mass and isolated yield.
a.gu: 1.Given:10.00g salicylic acid(M138.12),acetylating reagent excess;8.50g dry aspirin(M180.16). 2.Find:theoretical mass/isolated yield.
